newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat after mixed trading.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat after mixed trading.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed unchanged at 469.75/470.75 per dollar Tuesday after a mixed session in which the bolivar slipped back after firming during the morning, traders said.
"It was a very interesting session in which demand and supply was mixed," one trader said.
A plentiful supply of dollars in the morning saw the bolivar gain ground before slipping back as foreign currency demand appeared, traders said.
Currency trading on Wednesday will likely follow the Central Bank's weekly auction of monetary stabilization, or TEM, bills which are used as the benchmark to set interest rates, traders added.
